description: This file defines an interface for a Dictionary component within the WPEFramework project, including nested notification and iterator interfaces, with methods for registration, lookup, and modification notifications.

classes.name: IDictionary
classes.description: An interface that provides methods to interact with a key-value dictionary, including registration for notifications and accessors for getting and setting values.

classes.name: IDictionary::INotification
classes.description: An interface for receiving notifications about modifications within a namespace of the dictionary.

classes.name: IDictionary::IIterator
classes.description: An iterator interface for traversing dictionary entries within a namespace.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a sink object to receive notifications about changes in a specified namespace.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister a sink object from notifications in a specified namespace.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieve the value associated with a key in a namespace.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Set the value for a key within a namespace.

methods.name: Get (IIterator)
methods.description: Obtain an iterator for traversing entries in a namespace.

ctags.name: IDictionary
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL IDictionary : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: IIterator
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL IIterator : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: INotification
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
